tasks.contract: Stockroom.reserve(sku, quantity) returns false when the requested quantity is unavailable, and that failed reservation leaves every stock quantity unchanged. Existing successful-reservation and validation behavior remains supported.

Stockroom.low_stock(threshold) accepts a non-negative threshold and returns (sku, quantity) pairs for all quantities at or below the threshold, ordered by sku, without changing stock. A negative threshold raises ValueError. Existing stock lookup and successful-reservation behavior remains supported.

check.acceptance: low-stock results include the boundary in deterministic order
